CustomField.formula: IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Cancelled'), 'Cancelled', IF( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'PA Rejected'), 'PA Rejected', IF( Is_Expired__c, 'Expired', IF( AND( Total_TNP_Panels__c = 0, Total_Resulted_Panels__c = 0, Total_In_Progress__c = 0, Total_Partial_Resulted_Panels__c =0, !PWN_Success__c ), 'Registered', IF( AND( Total_TNP_Panels__c = 0, Total_Resulted_Panels__c = 0, Total_In_Progress__c = 0, Total_Partial_Resulted_Panels__c =0, PWN_Success__c, !Is_PWN_Approved__c ), 'PA Acknowledged', IF( AND( Total_TNP_Panels__c = 0, Total_Resulted_Panels__c = 0, Total_In_Progress__c = 0, Total_Partial_Resulted_Panels__c =0, Is_PWN_Approved__c ), 'PA Approved', IF( Total_Panels__c = Total_Resulted_Panels__c, 'Results Ready', IF( Total_Panels__c = Total_TNP_Panels__c, 'Results Ready', IF( AND( Total_In_Progress__c = 0, Total_Partial_Resulted_Panels__c =0, Total_TNP_Panels__c > 0, Total_Panels__c <> Total_Resulted_Panels__c, Total_Resulted_Panels__c > 0 ), 'Results Ready', IF( AND( OR( Total_Resulted_Panels__c > 0, Total_TNP_Panels__c > 0, Total_Partial_Resulted_Panels__c > 0 ), Total_In_Progress__c >= 0 ), 'Partial Results Ready', 'In Progress' ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) ) )
